thread:
Maya: Heads-up: BrightPath onboarding — need final SLO numbers for the customer-facing SLA doc. Customer expects 99.95% uptime and p95 latency targets by next Wed. Also need credit exposure for renewal discussion. Can ops + eng confirm numbers?
Sam: On it. From our telemetry, last 30d uptime = 99.96, p95 latency for gen endpoint = 220ms (steady). Will validate with SRE rollups.
Diego: @Sam can you share the exact query you run? we need consistent window. Also, do we include warmup/maintenance windows?
Sam: Query: SELECT count_if(success)/count(*) as uptime FROM requests WHERE ts BETWEEN now()-30d AND now(); for latency p95 as percentile(latency_ms,95). We exclude scheduled_maintenance tags. I’ll paste in a quick check.
Sam: `-- quick check
uptime: 0.9996
p95_latency_ms: 220`
Olivia: From runtime: for this customer we recommend SLOs: uptime 99.95% (30d rolling), p95 latency 250ms (30d). Set credit threshold: breach if uptime < 99.95 OR p95 > 300ms. Ops, agree?
Maya: That sounds reasonable. Priya (AM) and I will need the language for the customer doc and a one-paragraph comms blurb if we need to notify. Can you also provide the projected credit exposure if we hit a breach for one month?
Sam: Quick calc: monthly committed uptime expectation = 99.95% -> allowed downtime ~ 21.6 minutes. If we breach and offer a 5% service credit on monthly invoice ($20k MRR), exposure ~ $1k per month. If repeated, escalate.
Diego: :thumbsup: i'll add the SLO definitions to the internal dashboard and set an alert at 99.96 (to catch early). Also adding a latency regression monitor with a 10% relative increase trigger.
Maya: Perfect  can someone drop the final phrasing for the SLA section here? Need it by EOD so enablement can prepare the handoff.
Olivia: Draft: 'Redwood Inference commits to 99.95% uptime (30-day rolling) and p95 latency below 250ms for text-generation endpoints. Scheduled maintenance will be communicated 72 hours in advance and excluded from uptime calculations. In the event of an SLA breach, customers will be eligible for service credits per the contract: 5% monthly credit for a single-month breach, escalating per terms.'
Priya: I'll adapt that for the customer-facing one-pager and include the credit table + example calc. Thanks all.
Maya: Thanks team. I'll sync with enablement and schedule a short call with BrightPath next Tue. Marking action items: Sam: confirm queries + attach telemetry screenshots; Diego: add alerts; Olivia: final language; Priya: customer one-pager. I'll follow up.
